description: Na₁₂Mg₂Nb₄(SiO₄)₉ crystallizes in the trigonal P3c1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.85 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.99 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.41 Å) and three longer (2.64 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.41 Å) and three longer (2.74 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.52 Å) and three longer (2.63 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.00 Å) and three longer (2.20 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.06 Å) and three longer (2.12 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and three longer (2.12 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.98 Å) and three longer (2.06 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and three longer (2.04 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the fourth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.99 Å) and three longer (2.03 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.72 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra and corners with three NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-39°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.68 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra and corners with three NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-41°. There is one shorter (1.59 Å) and three longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃MgSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃NbSi trigonal bipyramids and faces with two equivalent ONa₃MgSi trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Nb, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃NbSi trigonal bipyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₃MgSi trigonal bipyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Nb, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃NbSi trigonal bipyramids. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Nb, and one Si atom.
